axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse; loaded waterline Y=0
geometrySource: Original surface and fitting reconstruction from HAER VA-132. No legacy voxel geometry, cube smoothing or downloaded third-party mesh is used.
accuracy: Major proportions and equipment stations follow the cited plans. Hull offsets are manually approximated from scanned lines, not a certified offsets table. Small fitting dimensions, weathering, plating joints and boat interiors are inferred. This candidate is an unarmed cargo exterior, omitting armed-guard guns, radar, gun tubs and later pipe/cable equipment. Visual dimensions do not define convoy GRT, armament, crew or economy. This is not a reconstruction of every national merchant in 1922 or 1936. Exterior only.
license: Original WNT1922 geometry and paint albedo remain under the project owner's LICENSE.md; no public reuse license is granted. Independently licensed Poly Haven maps remain CC0-1.0. Government reference drawings are not embedded as textures.
